mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_bible (project_id, one_sentence_premise, core_theme, main_conflict, ending_direction, world_background, power_system_json, hard_rules_json, style_guide, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{oneSentencePremise}, #{coreTheme}, #{mainConflict}, #{endingDirection}, #{worldBackground}, #{powerSystemJson}, #{hardRulesJson}, #{styleGuide}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE story_bible SET one_sentence_premise = #{oneSentencePremise}, core_theme = #{coreTheme}, main_conflict = #{mainConflict}, ending_direction = #{endingDirection}, world_background = #{worldBackground}, power_system_json = #{powerSystemJson}, hard_rules_json = #{hardRulesJson}, style_guide = #{styleGuide}, status = #{status} WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, one_sentence_premise, core_theme, main_conflict, ending_direction, world_background, power_system_json, hard_rules_json, style_guide, status, created_at, updated_at FROM story_bible WHERE project_id = #{projectId}
